body:
Recurrence record (Termal::Architect1 for Greg, via Engram::Advisor bac6ea2a #80/#81, 2026-10-24 17:3xZ; Greg: STOP EVERYTHING, record as a structural design failure). Evidence only; no fix proposed.

EVENTS: 06:28Z Greg sets the Engram project's turnGatedControl=false (after the begin-path grant_expired/grant_scope_mismatch regression under writer latency, w-d428620a6474; 8112 12:40Z/13:05Z). 06:43:32Z lane 12325 (w-bafe) and ~06:48Z Engram::Merger (w-66c2): termal_name_source_root → 409 "Engram control is not enabled for this session or its project" (Advisor #1695); filed as w-4af0c7eb90ac (Fable2 06:53Z, source read) with Architect2's full design decision at 06:58Z (note 4fc1a33c…: decouple naming/observation from admission; credit needs a producer-supported grant-free path; replacement C1–C3). No source change followed (w-cce8 exclusive priority, then STOP). ~16:5xZ the same cause stops the TermAl Merger ("Merger has no named source root"): a gate must run in a named root and no new root can be named while control is off; roots named before the switch keep working. The 10-22 containment case (8581 unreachable while control off) was the first visible form of the same coupling.

ASSUMPTIONS THAT ALLOWED IT (anchors on master): A1 "a name counts only for turns Engram mediates" (engram_source_roots.rs:1965-1974, require_runtime_enabled=true). A2 one predicate for three concerns: is_control_enabled = is_base_enabled() && turn_gated_control (engram_host_adapter.rs:208-210) gates admission, naming (engram_session_is_enabled_locked :3888) and check diagnostics (engram_turn_checks.rs:1900/2415/2657); no "base service" level exists between disabled and turn-gated. A3 credit requires an admitted grant (engram_turn_checks.rs:1668ff, 2010-2029, 2633ff); the grant-free ExecutionObserve shape is defined uncredited (engram_unadmitted_observation.rs:1-18, :348-383) and unwired. A4 the merge train rests on that credit (standing rule condition 3; `done` needs a host-recorded passed check), so control OFF makes every landing impossible except by Greg's override (10-22, w-06fb). A5 the switch was treated as safe containment without an inventory of what the predicate controls; the inventory appeared only after the fact (06:53Z/06:58Z). A6 the coupling is deliberate in the code comment and no test asserts the opposite; the first regression test is only proposed (w-4af0 C2). Conclusion: "may this turn run" was fused with "may this work be measured"; pulling the safety lever stops measurement, and measurement is what merging requires.
